messages:
maria-l: quick cross-team sync: we need a consistent audit taxonomy for customer exports and internal logs. main frictions: RBAC action granularity, KMS identifiers, and ensuring no PII leaks in exports.

alex-k: can we spell out exact fields we want in customer_export vs internal_full? a short mapping doc would help.

maria-l: proposal: event naming = domain.resource.action (e.g. auth.user.login, rbac.role.assign, kms.key.rotate). add 'family' (auth|rbac|kms|infra) and 'version' string that we bump on breaking changes.

samir: RBAC needs fine-grained actions: create/update/delete role, assign/revoke role, attach/detach policy. actor should be actor_id + actor_type (user|service). no emails in exported payloads; keep actor_email as nullable legacy field for a short transition.

jg: for KMS events customers want to map to their key but we cannot leak internal UUIDs. Can we provide a stable non-revealing ID?

maria-l: plan: include key_alias (when customer supplied) and key_digest = sha256(hex) of internal id. digest is deterministic so they can correlate without exposing internal identifiers. never include key_material or raw ids.

phil-s: resource paths (e.g., /org/123/proj/xyz/inst/456) are useful for debugging. default export should redact path; always include resource_hash = sha256(path). full_resource_path only via tenant opt-in after privacy/legal sign-off.

sec-bot: reminder: schema changes require migration plan + 30-day deprecation notice. follow internal policy at /security/audit-schema-changes.

alex-k: compatibility note: some downstreams expect actor_email. we'll emit actor_email for 60 days with a deprecation header and add actor_id + actor_type as canonical fields.

samir: decrypt events are sensitive. Log decrypt_attempt and result with metadata only: success, key_digest, ciphertext_digest, latency_ms, size_bucket ("<1KB","1-10KB",">10KB"). never log plaintext or exact byte sizes.

maria-l: also we should provide an event_family field for grouping when customers query exports (helps dashboards).

alex-k: for customer exports we should support an opt-in flag export.settings.actor_display_enabled that enables actor_display (human-readable) when tenant consents.

jg: i'll prepare a privacy checklist for opt-ins (full_resource_path, actor_display) and include threat model and mitigations.

phil-s: infra will host a schema validation webhook that validates and applies redaction rules for customer-facing exports. webhook should return structured rejection reasons and suggested redactions. eng-security owns the policy; infra owns service uptime and metrics.

maria-l: rollout plan: feature-flagged -> 2w internal -> 2w beta customers -> GA. observability: webhook rejects go to #incidents and create a pager if >5 rejections/hr for same tenant. keep reject logs TTL=7d.

samir: i'll start a library branch with helpers: libredwood.audit.fingerprint(key_id) and libredwood.audit.redact_resource(path).

alex-k: i'll build an endpoint->event mapping sheet (current API -> proposed event_name -> minimal_export_fields) by EOD Friday.

maria-l: action items: alex-k spreadsheet (EOD Fri), samir KMS redaction + size buckets (Mon), jg privacy sign-off checklist (Tue), phil-s actor_display opt-in flag + config (Wed), eng-security (maria-l) event_versioning policy + deprecation language (Wed).

ops-bot: scheduled: audit-taxonomy-handoff-demo on 2026-10-05 15:00 UTC. calendar invite sent.

phil-s: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
